what_it_is: Dynamatic Technologies Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered engineering company making aerostructures, hydraulic systems and precision components. Its aerospace division is a long-standing Airbus partner - flap track beam assemblies for single-aisle jets - and a Boeing P-8 structures supplier, with expanding military and civil aerostructure work.
india_angle: Airbus awarded Dynamatic the manufacturing and assembly contract for A220 Family doors in February 2024, and the Airbus board's first-ever India visit included its Bangalore facility - both high-visibility markers of India's rise as an aerostructure export base. Dynamatic's structures work also feeds Indian Navy P-8I maritime patrol aircraft.
intelligence_assessment: Dynamatic's OEM relationships are well evidenced through Airbus announcements and its own disclosures as a listed company. Defence-specific India revenue is a small share versus civil aerostructures; watch C-295 and P-8 follow-on structures awards for the military thread.
sites: Bengaluru Bengaluru, Karnataka Aerostructures (flap-track beams, fuselage sub-assemblies); hydraulic actuators; hydraulic pumps. Tier-1 supplier to Airbus for the A320/A330 family (flap-track beams); a C-295 role is not confirmed.

faq.q: What does Dynamatic make for Airbus?
faq.a: Flap track beam assemblies for Airbus single-aisle families and, since 2024, A220 Family doors manufactured in Bengaluru.
Yes - Dynamatic Technologies Limited is listed in India and headquartered at Dynamatic Park, Bengaluru.
